title: How to apply sunscreen
claims: Choose a sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher, water resistance and broad-spectrum (UVA and UVB) coverage.
Apply sunscreen before going outdoors; it takes approximately 15 minutes for the skin to absorb it.
Most adults need about 1 ounce (roughly a shot glass) to cover skin not covered by clothing; the face needs at least 1 teaspoon.
Reapply sunscreen every two hours when outdoors, and immediately after swimming or sweating.
Sunscreen should be applied to all skin not covered by clothing, including the neck, ears, tops of the feet and legs.
